# claude-blender

> Single-file Python CLI that turns natural language into runnable Blender (`bpy`) scripts via the Claude API, with optional live execution over the BlenderMCP socket. Pure Python, ARM-compatible, prompt-cached, flywheel-ready.

claude-blender is a commercial-grade bridge between Claude and Blender 4.x. It wraps the Anthropic SDK, caches the system prompt, and ships generated code to a running Blender over MCP in one command. It includes an EvoSkillOps flywheel for rating generations and exporting a fine-tune-ready corpus, a Space Metaverse demo catalog (Earth/Moon/Mars + cyberpunk) built for geospatial storytelling, and theme packs loaded from JSON files or HTTPS URLs.

## Code

- [blender_gen.py](./blender_gen.py): the whole CLI — argparse surface, Claude call, MCP socket, flywheel
- [requirements.txt](./requirements.txt): one dependency — `anthropic`
- [scenes/space_metaverse.py](./scenes/space_metaverse.py): geospatial Earth/Moon/Mars reference scene with Galileo markers, orbit curves, Copernicus climate overlay
- [scenes/cyberpunk_city.py](./scenes/cyberpunk_city.py): neon grid reference scene
- [themes_example.json](./themes_example.json): sample `--theme` payload (vaporwave/noir/solarpunk)
